_comment: Model registry for localAIStack.
Single source of truth for every local model the stack knows how to run.
Nothing here is downloaded implicitly: the registry declares what is
*available*, `.env` (LLM_MODEL / EMBED_MODEL) declares what is *selected*,
and Ollama decides what is *installed*.  GET /models joins all three.
It also pins the Ollama runtime version — see the `runtime` block below.
Consumers:
services/api/core/model_registry.py   loader + Ollama installed-state merge
services/api/routers/models.py        GET /models, GET /models/{id}
scripts/lib/models_registry.sh        setup.sh validation, `make model-pull`
scripts/lib/ollama_guard.sh           reads runtime.pinned_version
.github/workflows/ollama-pin.yml      opens a PR when the pin falls behind
Adding a model:
1. Append an entry below (id is stable and kebab-case; tag is the exact
Ollama tag `ollama pull` receives).
2. `make model-pull ID=<id>`
3. Point .env at it if it should become the selected llm/embedding.
Field notes:
aliases       Equivalent tags that resolve to this entry (an explicit
quant spelling of the same weights). Lookup-only.
role          llm | embedding — which slot the model can fill.
source.kind   ollama-library (public pull) | modelfile (local build).
install       selected  — pulled by setup.sh only when .env points at it
on-demand — never automatic; `make model-pull ID=<id>`
modelfile — built locally by setup.sh from source.modelfile
min_ram_gb    Host RAM floor for usable speed at this quantization, NOT a
hard limit. Entries above the host's RAM stay listed and are
reported by GET /models with fits_host=false.
status        supported | experimental | broken (see notes for why).

runtime.name: ollama
_comment: Single source of truth for the Ollama version this repo targets.
scripts/lib/ollama_guard.sh reads pinned_version from here — do not
hardcode a version anywhere else, including docs.
pinned_version is a FLOOR, not an equality. setup.sh/start.sh install it
when Ollama is absent or older, and accept anything newer rather than
downgrading a host that has moved ahead. Set OLLAMA_STRICT_PIN=1 to
require the exact version (reproducibility runs, bisecting a regression).
checked_at / latest_known are maintained by .github/workflows/ollama-pin.yml,
which polls ollama/ollama weekly and opens a PR when this pin falls behind.

llm._comment: Matches .env.example LLM_MODEL. config.py's hardcoded fallback is the equivalent llama3.1:8b-q4_K_M tag.

embedding._comment: Matches .env.example EMBED_MODEL + EMBED_DIM=768. config.py's hardcoded fallback is still ternary-bonsai:4, which is currently broken — see that entry.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
models.notes: Default chat/RAG generator. Best quality-per-GB on a 16 GB M-series host.

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
models.notes: Fast smoke-test generator — use when iterating on graph wiring rather than answer quality.

models.name: Mistral 7B Instruct
models.notes: Strong extractive reasoning; a good A/B partner against llama3.1-8b on corrective-RAG grading.

models.name: Phi-3.5 Mini Instruct
models.notes: Tight instruction-following at small size. No native tool-calling — avoid for /graph/agent.

models.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 4B
models.notes: Agentic model built for tool use and reasoning, with a unified reasoning/non-reasoning mode. 256K context at 2.8 GB makes it the best tool-calling fit on a 16 GB host for /graph/agent — it carries far more retrieved context than llama3.1-8b at half the footprint. Languages: en, de, es, fr, it, ja.

models.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B
models.notes: Hybrid Mamba-2/MoE sibling of nemotron-3-nano-4b: 1M context, 3.5B active parameters. Listed for hosts larger than the 16 GB M1 Pro baseline — it will swap and crawl below ~48 GB, so GET /models reports fits_host=false there. `nemotron-3-nano:latest` resolves to this variant, which is why the registry pins explicit :4b / :30b tags.

models.name: Nomic Embed Text v1.5
models.notes: Working default embedder. embed_dim 768 must match EMBED_DIM and the existing localai_docs Qdrant collection — recreate the collection when swapping embedders.

models.name: Ternary Bonsai 4B (Qwen3-4B, BitNet Q1_0)
models.notes: Registers and appears in the Open WebUI dropdown, but inference and embeddings return HTTP 500 (file_type=unknown): the prism-ml repo ships only a Q1_0/BitNet GGUF that Ollama's bundled GGML does not recognize. Blocked on upstream TQ1_0 support in ollama/ollama. Note embed_dim is 2560, not the 768 that EMBED_DIM defaults to — selecting this as the embedder needs a matching Qdrant collection as well as a working runtime.
